overall_goal: Measure and set aside 200g of basmati rice

goals.description: Open the rice bag and scoop the initial portion into the weighing bowl
goals.rationale: The person grabs and opens the rice bag, picks up a tumbler, and scoops the first batch of rice into the bowl on the scale.

goals.description: Scoop and pour additional rice to reach the required measurement
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly scoops more rice from the bag and carefully pours it into the bowl to match the exact recipe amount.

goals.description: Remove the measured rice from the scale and set it aside
goals.rationale: The person takes the bowl off the scale, levels the rice, and places it on the countertop.
